newsitem.title: UK: Moss Bros current same store sales up 11pct.
newsitem.headline: Moss Bros current same store sales up 11pct.

text.p: Like-for-like sales for menswear clothing company Moss Bros Group Plc were up 11 percent in the first eight weeks of the second half, finance director Terry Donovan told Reuters in an interview.
Moss Bros said first-half like-for-like sales were up 14 percent.

Earlier the company had said first half pretax profits were up 54 percent to 4.9 4 million stg over the same period a year ago and paid out an interim dividend of 6.5 pence per share, up from five pence previously.
